title: The UK sanctions should target activity 'supporting or maintaining' settlements, Tayab Ali says
summary:
The UK sanctions should target activity 'supporting or maintaining' settlements, Tayab Ali says

Tayab Ali, Director of the International Centre of Justice for Palestinians, tells MEE’s Imran Mulla that the upcoming ban on trade with illegal Israeli settlements, expected to be announced on Tuesday by UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, will have a ‘profound impact’ on Israel.

The ban is expected to bring the UK into compliance with the International Court of Justice’s July 2024 advisory opinion, Whitehall sources told MEE.

The ICJ opinion declared Israel’s occupation of Palestinian territory unlawful and said states, including the UK, were obligated to take steps to oppose it.

As part of the measures, the UK is expected to prohibit investment in businesses operating in Israeli settlements.

Tayab Ali tells MEE that UK sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements should make it unlawful for British citizens, companies and investors to engage in any activity that supports or maintains Israel’s occupation. pic.twitter.com/ufzpzS1CUd

— Middle East Eye (@MiddleEastEye) September 7, 2026

title: Two Alleged ‘TeamPCP’ Hackers Arrested in Australia
summary:
Authorities in Australia have arrested two men believed to be members of TeamPCP, a prolific cybercrime and data extortion group blamed for perpetrating the longest running spree of software supply chain attacks ever.

In a statement released today, the Australian Federal Police (AFP) said two unnamed suspects from Western Australia, aged 21 and 23, were arrested in connection with a "sophisticated cybercrime syndicate that allegedly created malicious open-source software to rob thousands of global businesses."

The AFP did not name the defendants, but KrebsOnSecurity learned the 21-year-old suspect's real identity in June, and has been communicating with him ever since. This story includes interviews with TeamPCP's self-described spokesperson, and examines clues left behind by the TeamPCP leader that likely led to his undoing.

title: Hamas accuses Israel of attempts at 'obliterating evidence' of crimes in Gaza
summary:
Hamas accuses Israel of attempts at 'obliterating evidence' of crimes in Gaza

Hamas late on Monday accused Israel of trying to conceal the evidence of "brutal crimes" committed against Palestinians in Gaza amid its genocidal war for over two years. 

The movement said Israel attempted to "obliterate evidence" through "removing, crushing and relocating the rubble", despite the presence of "bodies of thousands of missing people and material evidence of the crimes of genocide committed by the occupation over two years".

"Tampering with these sites, with what they contain of bodies and evidences, constitutes a violation of international law and the International Court of Justice's ruling calling for the preservation of evidence, as well as an affront to the dignity of the martyrs and the right of their families to recover and bury the bodies of their loved ones," the statement read. 

Hamas urged the UN, international courts and relevant authorities to "take urgent action to protect these sites" as well as deploying international investigation teams and forensic experts to oversee the recovery of bodies and the documentation and preservation of evidence. 

"We emphasize that the swift removal of rubble and the reconstruction of Gaza are an urgent humanitarian and national necessity and an inalienable right of our people," it added.

title: Iran slams Canada for appeasing 'bullying neighbour' US
summary:
Iran slams Canada for appeasing 'bullying neighbour' US

Iranian foreign ministry spokesperson, Esmaeil Baqaei, has accused Canada of "appeasing" the US after two of its ministers issued a joint statement saying the country would maintain "significant pressure" on Tehran. 

"On the very day the U.S. president, in blatant contempt for Canada’s sovereignty and independence, portrayed the entire country as part of the United States, Canada’s foreign and finance ministers chose to further appease their bullying neighbor - this time by targeting Iran with a statement that distorts every fact about the situation in our region," Baqaei said in a post on X. 

He added that Ottawa cannot present itself as a champion of "‘peace and security’, ‘freedom of navigation’, and ‘international law’" as he says it continues to back Washington’s "military aggression" and "illegal, interventionist actions in our region".

"This is neither 'diplomacy' nor 'responsible statecraft'. It is a display of strategic confusion and submission to intimidation - a choice that will not even shield Canada itself from American bullying and aggression."

Baqaei's remarks come after Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand and Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne said in a joint statement that Ottawa is "working closely with partners, including within G7, to maintain significant pressure on Iran".

This includes support for efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and continued sanctions on Iran, such as the US-led Operation Economic Outcast, the statement indicated. The ministers added that the country will continue to seek "additional measures" with global partners to force Tehran to end its "malign behavior".

title: Israeli ministers call for sanctions on Britain over Falkland Islands
summary:
Israeli ministers call for sanctions on Britain over Falkland Islands

Israeli Ministers Itamar Ben Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich have called for Israel to sanction Britain over the Falkland Islands, as the UK government prepares to announce a ban on trade with illegal Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territory. 

Smotrich, Israel's finance minister, called for the expulsion of the British ambassador to Israel and said: "We will not be a trampled doormat of an antisemitic government, in a country conquered by radical Islam, trying to save itself from economic and social decline by attacking Jews and the State of Israel. The British Mandate in the Land of Israel is over." 

Ben Gvir, the security minister, posted on X in Spanish calling on Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to sanction Britain for its "occupation" of the Falkland Islands. 

"The British are not content with merely occupying the territory; they also carry out oil drilling there and steal the money from the Argentine people."

title: US says ‘redirected’ 94 vessels in Strait of Hormuz
summary:
US says ‘redirected’ 94 vessels in Strait of Hormuz

The US “redirected 94 commercial vessels, disabled 3 and boarded 2” since the US reimposed its blockade of Iranian ports in mid-July, according to the US Central Command.
